moat_against: No individual patent or group of patents is essential to the business (company disclosure) — moat is execution, not protected IP
ROIC proxy 2.5% (FY2023), 4.5% (FY2024), 4.9% (FY2025) — persistently below cost of capital after the $4.95B Altra deal
PES motors/fans are near-commodity and ride weak residential HVAC/pool demand (organic -6.6% in Q2 2026)
Contested by larger rivals in every segment: ABB, Siemens, Emerson, Rockwell, Timken, SKF
Net debt $4.267B = 7.9x normalized OE — leverage leaves no room for a bad cycle
moat_for: Installed base of mission-critical components where downtime cost dwarfs part cost — sticky spec-in and aftermarket demand
Full powertrain/motion subsystem breadth from the Rexnord + Altra portfolios, enabling cross-sell
AMC precision brands (Kollmorgen, Portescap, Thomson) with design-in positions in medical, robotics, aerospace & defense, data-center power
Gross margin expansion 27.7% (FY2021) to 37.4% (FY2025) on mix shift and pricing
moat_justification: Installed-base and aftermarket stickiness in mission-critical powertrain components plus AMC precision design-ins, but no essential IP (company's own disclosure), a near-commodity PES motor business, and ROIC proxy of only 2.5-4.9% across FY2023-25 — pricing power has not converted to capital returns through the Altra cycle.
name: Regal Rexnord Corporation
one_liner: Levered industrial roll-up, moat 4/10 — does not clear 15% at $154.01 (weighted IRR 8.5%, IV@15% $72.69); it would need to fall to ~$73 to clear the hurdle on the normalized $8.11/share base.
